name: @topo/core
description: Structural analysis for codebases — spectral decomposition, clustering, role classification. Powered by WASM.

scripts.build:wasm: cd ../topo-core && wasm-pack build --target web --features wasm --no-default-features --out-dir pkg && cp pkg/topo_core_bg.wasm ../topo-web/wasm/ && cp pkg/topo_core.js ../topo-web/wasm/ && cp pkg/topo_core.d.ts ../topo-web/wasm/
scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:site
